description: Arcane's single policy surface. Every allow/deny answer in the package resolves here — no adapter, alias, or gate holds its own allow/deny logic (S02 acceptance: 'adapters do not contain divergent allow/deny logic', enforced by policyDuplicationAudit). Changing this file changes runtime behavior without a code edit; that property is asserted by tests/s02-policy.test.mjs.

effectRules.note: Scoped by the contract's scope.own[] at the gate; policy allows the class, the gate owns the path.
Deletion is not recoverable from the diff alone, so it carries an approval digest.
A command's *effects* are gated by the receipts it produces; exec itself is allowed under a capability. An unknown exit-0 command is an observation, never proof (S04).
Downgraded to 'observed' honestly: no host adapter in this baseline can broker egress, so claiming 'strong' would be false.
Denied by default. Arcane never prints or inspects credentials; a policy that wants this must say so explicitly, and even then the gate refuses without an approval digest.
Mutates the lockfile dimension, which stales dependent evidence (S05). Approval-bound so the invalidation is never a surprise.
Outward-facing and hard to reverse. Denied by default; a deliberate policy change plus an approval digest is required.
Deliberately NOT a catch-all. Unclassified operations hit unclassifiedEffect:'deny' and are refused by name; they are never quietly bucketed here. See EFFECT_CLASS_RECONCILIATION in lib/policy.mjs.

capability.note: Single-use by default: a capability authorizes one effect, so a replayed or reused grant cannot ride a stale authorization.

replay.note: Greenfield — S00 finding 3 confirmed predecessor has no nonce, sequence, or freshness window anywhere to port.

hostEnforcement.note: A host without working interception cannot be labeled strong. These are minimum levels each operation class demands, not a description of any particular host.

signoff.note: Deterministic evidence only. Requiring 'measured' as well would block signoff on any change that legitimately has nothing to measure — a policy that cannot be satisfied is not a stronger policy, it is one that gets waived.

highRisk.note: High-risk completion requires deterministic evidence, strong enforcement, & a producer-bound intent/blast-radius/why-safe context. Optional Covenant challenge is advisory & cannot satisfy or block release prerequisites.

degradation.note: If the pre-effect gate is unavailable, mutation-bearing operations fail closed; read-only operations may continue with a recorded enforcement-health downgrade. This is a deliberate divergence from predecessor behavior recorded in compatibility provenance.

retention.note: Digests are preserved even when payload retention is limited.

lockedDomains.note: This is the rhook enforcement plane; completion requires deterministic evidence, strong enforcement, & intent/blast-radius/why-safe context.
